hours prior to the meeting.

ROLL CALL

Councilmembers Present: Saro, Thrash-Ntuk, Kerr

Also present: Joshua Hickman, Acting Director of Public Works, Vanessa Ibarra, Deputy City
Attorney, Karen Baldwin, Senior City Clerk Analyst, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-56582  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Mobility, Ports, and Infrastructure
  Committee meeting of Tuesday, May 6, 2025.

  A motion was made by Vice Chair Thrash-Ntuk, seconded by Chair Kerr, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Saro, Thrash-Ntuk, Kerr
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

2.  25-56583  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Public Works
  Department on the System Impact Report and System Use Policy of the approved
  California pilot program under CVC 22425-22431 to deploy automated speed
  safety systems to reduce speeding, traffic collisions, and traffic related fatalities in
  the City of Long Beach.

  A motion was made by Chair Kerr, seconded by Member Saro, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3 Saro, Thrash-Ntuk, Kerr
